title: v4.1.4 compact OpenClaw configuration recovery
script: $dst='C:/3EN-Agent/openclaw-bridge/openclaw-v414-recover-config.ps1'; Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri ('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/3en4all/3en-command-runner/main/scripts/openclaw-v414-recover-config.ps1?ts='+[DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow.ToUnixTimeMilliseconds()) -OutFile $dst; $t=$null;$e=$null; [System.Management.Automation.Language.Parser]::ParseFile($dst,[ref]$t,[ref]$e)|Out-Null; if(@($e).Count -gt 0){throw ('V414_CONFIG_SCRIPT_SYNTAX_FAILED count='+@($e).Count)}; & powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File $dst; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw ('V414_CONFIG_SCRIPT_FAILED code='+$LASTEXITCODE)}
